Name: Tiny Plane
Description: An endless flier: keep a tiny plane in the air as long as you can, collecting coins and points along the way.

Achievements.Name: 50 Coins
Achievements.Description: Finish a single game with a total of 50 coins or more.

Achievements.Name: 200 Coins
Achievements.Description: Finish a single game with a total of 200 coins or more.

Achievements.Name: 500 Coins
Achievements.Description: Finish a single game with a total of 500 coins or more.

Achievements.Name: No Items Please
Achievements.Description: Play the game for at least 1 minute without picking up an item.

Achievements.Name: 1000 Points
Achievements.Description: End a single game with a total of 1000 points or more.

Achievements.Name: 5000 Points
Achievements.Description: End a single game with a total of 5000 points or more.

Achievements.Name: 10000 Points
Achievements.Description: End a single game with a total of 10000 points or more.

Achievements.Name: Accumulate 5000 Coins
Achievements.Description: Accumulate a total of 5000 coins total in the game.

Achievements.Name: Accumulate 10000 Coins
Achievements.Description: Accumulate a total of 10000 coins total in the game.

Achievements.Name: Accumulate 20000 Coins
Achievements.Description: Accumulate a total of 20000 coins total in the game.

Achievements.Name: Accumulate 40000 Coins
Achievements.Description: Accumulate a total of 40000 coins total in the game.

Achievements.Name: Turbo Man
Achievements.Description: Go thru at least 15 turbos in one single game.

Achievements.Name: Stuck from both sides
Achievements.Description: At any point in a game, pickup a balloon and a weight at the same time.

Achievements.Name: 5 Bomb Survivals
Achievements.Description: Go thru at pleast 5 bombs with the sheild equipped during one game.

Achievements.Name: Unlocked Hardcore Mode
Achievements.Description: End the game with a minimum of 2000 points to unlock hardcore mode.

Achievements.Name: 300 Fruit
Achievements.Description: Pickup a minimum of 300 fruit during a single game.
